description: This source file defines a FastAPI application with two POST endpoints for handling file uploads: one accepting raw bytes and another accepting an UploadFile object. It includes route handlers that process incoming files and respond with either the file size or filename.

methods.name: create_file(file: Annotated[bytes | None, File()] = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/files/' endpoint; processes an uploaded file as bytes or None and returns its size or an error message.

methods.name: create_upload_file(file: UploadFile | None = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/uploadfile/' endpoint; processes an uploaded file as UploadFile or None and returns its filename or an error message.

ctags.name: create_file
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_file(file: Annotated[bytes | None, File()] = None):$/
